<script>
(() => {
  const q = document.getElementById('exp-search'), rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.exp tbody tr')], none = document.getElementById('exp-none');
  q.addEventListener('input', () => {
    const s = q.value.trim().toLowerCase(); let n = 0;
    rows.forEach(r => { const show = !s || r.dataset.s.includes(s); r.hidden = !show; n += show; });
    none.hidden = n > 0;
  });
})();
</script>
